calibration.note: Unset. The first retro sets it from Jay's usage meter: percent of the week used across an epic, divided into that epic's units. Until then status lines show units, never a percent.

weights.note: Starting values from list-price ratios (cache read 0.1x and cache write 1.25x of input, output 5x; opus 5/3 of sonnet, haiku 1/3). Not measured against the weekly meter; a retro recalibrates them and says why.

builder.note: opus only where the critical read names the step design-heavy

fix.note: always a fresh agent, at most 10 findings
